title: Authentication - Neo4j Aura
snippet: | The Aura API uses OAuth 2.0 for API authentication. Creating credentials AuraDB Virtual Dedicated Cloud users, and AuraDS Enterprise users have unrestricted access to creating API credentials. However, users with Free and Professional instances must have entered billing information or be a member of a marketplace project before they can create API credentials. API credentials are linked to the user account, inheriting its capabilities and roles. The API credentials never expire unless you delete them.

title: Neo4j Pricing & API Plans | APIs.io
snippet:
Neo4J Plans Pricing is the pricing profile for [Neo4j](https://apis.io/providers/neo4j/) on the [APIs.io](https://apis.io/) network — every figure transcribed verbatim from the provider’s own pricing page on 2026-10-28.
It defines 11 plans, including *AuraDB Free* — $0; *AuraDB Professional* — Starting at $0.09 /GB/hour*; *AuraDB Business Critical* — Starting at $0.20 /GB/hour*, and 8 more.
The page prices API or platform usage directly, priced by usage; the service is delivered as open-core.

| Plan | Price | Includes | Overage |
|---|---|---|---|
| AuraDB Free | $0 | Limits on node and relationship counts; single-zone; community support | — |
| AuraDB Professional | Starting at $0.09 /GB/hour* per GB/hour | Up to 128GB memory per instance (minimum 1GB instance), daily backups 7-day retention | — |
| AuraDB Business Critical | Starting at $0.20 /GB/hour* per GB/hour | Up to 2TB memory instance (GCP) & 512GB (AWS & Azure), minimum 2GB instance, 99.95% uptime SLA, 24x7 support | — |
| AuraDB Virtual Dedicated Cloud | Contact Us | VPC isolation, hourly backups 60-day retention | — |
| Aura Graph Analytics | $0.40 /GB/hour per GB/hour | Up to 512 GB (RAM), unlimited concurrent sessions | — |
| AuraDS Enterprise | Contact Us | 8-384GB (RAM), custom pricing | — |
| Community Edition | Download Free | GPL3-licensed with community support | — |
| Enterprise Edition | Contact Sales | All community features plus clustering, security | — |
| Infinigraph Edition | Contact Sales | Enterprise features plus automatic sharding, GDS included | — |
| Graph Data Science community | Start for Free | Maximum of 4 CPU cores, open source | — |
| Graph Data Science enterprise | Contact Us | Self-hosted annual licensing, premium support | — |

Calls without `X-API-Key` need no key. Calls with it need a paid plan — [get a key](https://apis.io/developer/account/?access=1).

title: neo4j.com/blog/startups/neo4j-aura-startup-guide
snippet:
And the tiers themselves, if you just want the numbers:
- **Free**: $0. Learn and prototype, with one free instance per account and every graph tool included.
- **Professional**: $65/GB/month, 1GB minimum. Up to 128GB memory per instance, scalable on demand, daily backups.
- **Business Critical**: $146/GB/month, 2GB minimum. Up to 1944GB (GCP) or 512GB (AWS/Azure), a 99.95% uptime SLA, and 24×7 support.
